title: Linh's Noodle Pronunciation Challenge
segments: Linh proudly served a bowl of 'hủ tiếu' to new international customers at 'Hương Vị Quê Nhà'. She tried to explain the dish's unique flavors, but her English pronunciation made it difficult. They looked confused. Linh felt a pang of disappointment. Her dream of reaching more people online, especially through TikTok Shop, seemed harder than she thought.

Because of this, Linh decided she needed to improve her English pronunciation quickly. Her dream of reaching more people online, especially through TikTok Shop, was too important. She spent the evening searching for language learning apps. Linh wanted an app that focused on food-related terms and allowed her to record herself practicing. Finally, she found one that looked promising.
